labels.about: a block or a fact is about its target
labels.caused-by: an event was caused by its target
labels.derived-from: a record was derived from its target
labels.implements: an implementation implements the contract revision it pins (TY-11)
labels.part-of: a block is part of its target
labels.supersedes: a block replaces the pinned revision of its target (RF-12)
labels.uses: a block uses its target: a stage its ports, a setup its bindings
labels.verifies: a test set or a check verifies its target (TY-13)
